_comment: Per-project config. Everything niche-specific lives here; the pipeline and ad templates are shared. Copy this folder to start a second product.
name: montisella
market: upper back, shoulder and neck pain sufferers (UK/US)

filter._comment: Skill-01 filtering. TOPIC decides whether an item is about this market at all; the rest score relevance. Regexes are case-insensitive. Replace all of these for a new niche.
filter.topic: \b(shoulder|shoulder blade|upper back|upper[- ]back|thoracic|trap(?:s|ezius)?|rhomboid|scapula|scapular|neck pain|posture|rotator cuff|impingement|frozen shoulder|between (?:my |the )?shoulder blades|bra strap|binder|side sleep|sleeping on (?:my )?side|pillow)\b

compliance._comment: Which qa.py ruleset applies. 'health_adjacent' is the strict Meta wellness set in qa.py. A non-health product would use a different profile.
compliance.notes: Felt experience only. Never: corrects posture, realigns spine/neck, relieves nerve compression, treats or cures a named condition.

model._effort_note: high is the default; xhigh for the hardest synthesis. Sweep on your own output before settling.
